text: Every plate that prints the pin-hinge key holder supplies fresh required loose fittings as separately identifiable objects: one standard hinge pin, centre clip and spare, slide-in OP1 retainer, two-post bar and both touch-board clips. Do not routinely print a second alternative-fit hinge pin. Socket backing strips are optional assembly tools; omit unnecessary duplicate strips and battery covers, and explain any included rectangular tool.
Place loose functional pins, clips and slide-in fittings separately on the plate so they can be identified and fitted without breaking them off the holder.
Include inexpensive spare loose clips and other easily lost small fittings with shipped hardware. Provide for an optional component and spares pack before release.
